buyer_added_terms.text: ेेतताा ाारराा जजोोड़ड़ गगईई बबडड कक ववशशेषेष शशतत

1. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I) Eligibility Criteria: The CAMC of Centralized AC Plant should be carried out by OEM M/s V OLTAS Limited only. Hence OEM only should participate in the Tender . Quotations from oth ers will be rejected. II) Scope of AMC: (a) Centralized Air Conditioning plants equipments such as Compressors, Chillers, Condensers, AHU’s, Cooling towers, Pumps etc., and other allied equipments are to be serviced six times in a year (b) All breakdown calls shall be attended during the contract period. st th (c) AMC Period : 1 Year AMC Period from Date : 10 December 2026 th to 09 December 2027 (Tentatively) nd th th 2 Year : AMC Period from Dt : 10 December 2027 To 09 December 2028 (Tentatively) (d) Total Tonnage : 154TR x 4nos & 100TR X 1nos Central AC plant (f) Work Place : Bharat Dynamics Limited, Visakhapatnam Unit. TERMS AND CONDITIONS: i) The firm/ contractor shall deploy one supervisor, two technicians and required unskilled persons for maintenance of A.C. plant and report to dept. in charge whenever regular works are being carried out. ii) The service reports should be duly certified by the concerned section/ dept. in charge. iii) The service engineer of the firm shall visit regularly to take feed back from concerned section/ dept. in charge iv) The firm/ contractor’s representative shall not loiter in BDL premises. v) The firm/contractor shall have a valid license under the Labour Contract Act and rules framed there under, before the commencement

of the work and continue to hold till the completion of the contract. vi) The technician has to go through BDL logbook and shall report to concerned section/ dept. in charge. The firm / contractor has to maintain logbooks and has to record all the maintenance activities and details of spares changed on daily basis. vii) In case of the non-satisfactory service of the technician, on direction of BDL the technician has to be removed and a new technician has to be posted in BDL. viii)Payment Terms: Quarterly payment against submission of Invoice, Service Reports and completion of services duly certified by indenter and within 30 days from the submission of Original Invoice. ix) No transport will be provided by BDL to your staff. The firm/ contractor shall be only responsible for the conduct of his workmen, agents and representatives. x) The contractor is solely responsible for any damage injury or accident that occur to any of his personnel during work i.e., will not claim any compensation from BDL xi) TDS under income tax and other taxes if any, as applicable shall be deducted from the Contractor’s bill. xii) The firm/ contractor and his agents, representatives, workmen etc., shall strictly within observe the order pertaining to fire precautions prevailing within the restricted area. xiii) The firm/contractor, his agents, reps, workmen, shall be strictly and adhere to the fire precautionary measures while working near the explosive area. During such times their engineer in charge shoul head the workmen as precautionary measures. xiv) During the contract period if any equipment of the plant found unused permanently by the user, such equipment shall be deleted from the contract. xv) Reporting the healthiness of the plant and suggesting improvements if any. xvi) Deduction: If the plant is shut down due to lack of maintenance the amount from the bill would be proportionately deducted for the

number of days of shut down. . 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) i) Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation a. Copy of PAN Card b. Copy of GSTIN c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque d. Copy of EFT mandate duly certified by Bank ii) Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST% iii) The vendor participating in the tender should declare if demerged in the recent times, to declare the merge, nature of demerger for the assessment of the credentials for acceptance of your quotations, falling on which knowing of the demerger in the later stage by BDL, BDL will entitle the vendor for debarment. iv) The bidder should submit the compliance statement for acceptance of Scope of AMC, Work, Bill of quantities and all terms & conditions mentioned in the bid along with the bid documents. v) While generating invoice in GEM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. vi) Price to be quoted as per the Cost Break Up Sheet (Price Schedule) as attached. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) i) Centralized air conditioning plants equipments such as Compressors, Chillers, Condensers, AHU’s, Cooling towers, Pumps etc, and other allied equipments are to be serviced six times in a year. One of those service should be before onset of summer. The firm/ contractor has to

carry out maintenance of the equipment as per the check list (daily, monthly, quarterly/half yearly/yearly) provided by the manufacturer. All breakdown calls to be attended as and when required at free of cost. ii) Supply of various refrigerants, compressor oil for re-charging & topping-up and supply of nitrogen to trace the leaks at free of cost. The compressors should be checked periodically for their performance. If any defects noticed while periodical check up, maintenance are to be rectified inclusive of spares required to be supplied and replaced at free of cost. iii) Rewinding/ repair to all motors of compressors, blowers / AHUs, Repairs / Replacement of VFD, Condensers pumps, chiller pumps, Cooling towers etc. (inclusive of bearings and other parts) free of cost. iv) Various couplings, bearings and belts etc., are required for day to day maintenance of air conditioning plant to be supplied and replaced as and when required at free of cost. v) Various electrical switchgear connected and relevant to air conditioning plants are to be replaced as and when required at free of cost. vi) Repair/replacement of all measuring and controlling instruments like temperature, humidity, pressure control devices, gauges, thermostats, expansion valves, pressure switches, solenoid valves, overload / over current protection devices and other safety interlocking devices for compressor motors, evaporation Blower motors, condenser pump motors and chiller pumps motors water regulators, capacity control valves, safety switches, timers etc., are to be carried out at free of cost. vii) Repair and servicing of all electrical control panels, contactors and relays, MCCB. Checking of electrical connections and wiring and replacement of fuses & relays contactors etc., at free of cost. viii)The de-scaling of condensers is to be carried out as and when discharge is out of specified limits. ix) Servicing and replacement of cooling tower’s Nozzles, drain pipes, Ball cocks, sprinklers, strainers etc., as and when required at free of cost.

x) All the safety controls, HP, LP, COP etc., are to be checked periodically for their performance, if found defective to be replaced at free of cost. xi) Servicing of cooling coils, fins, micro filters, exhaust valves etc., are to be carried out periodically. Servicing of chillers, attending any kind of minor leaks in the pipes. xii) Painting of all the equipments to be carried out free of cost during winter season in contract period. xiii)The temperature and humidity conditions should be maintained within the designed conditions and as per AS9100D standards. xiv) The firm/ contractor shall necessary to keep sufficient stocks of spares, consumables, electrical items & switch gear items etc at their stores which are required for breakdown maintenance & preventive maintenance and to avoid any delays in completing service calls. 6.
